llm.summary: This skill is a documentation-writing helper with broad activation wording but no hidden execution, persistence, credential access, or unrelated data handling.

dimensions.detail: The referenced file reads, edits, grep checks, and slop-detector use are proportionate to documentation generation and remediation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown skill and module files only, with no executable install scripts; metadata discloses its Night Market source and related configuration dependencies.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Some triggers such as "writing," "generation," and "polish" are broad and could activate for general writing requests, but the runtime instructions remain documentation-scoped.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No background workers, persistence mechanisms, privilege escalation, credential use, destructive actions, or broad local indexing were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact consistently focuses on generating and remediating documentation, checking writing quality, preserving technical intent, and requesting approval for major document changes.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want an opinionated documentation drafting and cleanup workflow. Be aware it may activate for broad writing-related requests, so review when it is invoked and confirm major rewrites before allowing changes.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] unexpected: The broad trigger wording is a real scoping weakness, but it does not pair with high-impact authority or hidden behavior; the skill instructions themselves stay aligned with documentation work.
